messages:
sam (DevEx): Quick note: a user hit a 400 when running the Node quickstart for embeddings. REST worked fine.

eli (SDK): Repro: our quickstart sends {modelName: 'embed-lite-v1', input:[...]} and server returns 400 unknown parameter 'modelName'. REST curl using 'model' succeeds.

tara (Runtime): Runtime validation only accepts 'model' ATM. We locked schema after last migration.

eli (SDK): I'll add a client shim to rename modelName -> model and add a unit test asserting outgoing JSON.

sam (DevEx): Please also update quickstart docs to show 'model' until we stabilize. Add a troubleshooting blurb.

tara (Runtime): I'll add a short-lived alias on the ingestion layer and emit telemetry for occurrences.

eli (SDK): Also found auth retry flakiness: SDK auto-refresh retries but sample app orchestration can race and yield 401s. I'll add an integration test that forces token expiry with concurrent calls.

ci-bot: Build started for eli/embeddings-fix (#89) :rocket:

sam (DevEx): Action items: eli: shim + tests + patch; tara: alias + telemetry; sam: docs update. Thanks — ping here when CI green.
